summary: CHANGES_REQUESTED at head c4f58e44aaf58259bff3dba1f11b8be2dff0780c (code tip 7bc83404): the Legion-side diff is clean; the one blocking finding is in the fork release this PR pins. In sjawhar/oh-my-pi f3278eed, session-storage-config.ts:76 constructs `new SQL(dsn)` outside the try, so a connection string Bun cannot parse (a libpq keyword string like `host=db user=legion password=hunter2`) throws a TypeError whose message embeds the whole string, escapes main.ts's catch, and is dumped by cli.ts's `fatal` to stderr and OMP's log — password included. That breaks the spec's 'never printing the connection string' contract and makes docs/kubernetes.md line 172 false at this pin. Fix: fork commit (construct inside the try, refuse without the string, one test), operator cuts a release, OMP_FORK_PIN bumped here, one docs row. Everything else is fast-follow cleanup. Fork-bar ruling: one seam, one resolver, 24 mechanical swaps, DRY, zero Legion names — meets Sami's bar once the blocking fix and two minors (startup-composer prepaint list reads files under sql; two unused exports) land in the same fork commit.
